events.body:
## Context

blt-docs has no row in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`, though its README says a strict build is required. `docs/developer-guide/deployment.md` never names the deploy command.

## What to do

1. Add `blt-docs\tpython\tpip install -r requirements.txt && mkdocs build --strict` to `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`.
2. Fix any strict-mode warnings it exposes.
3. Mention `scripts/ci/test.sh blt-docs` and `scripts/deploy.sh blt-docs` in deployment.md.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `scripts/ci/test.sh blt-docs` passes
- [ ] deployment.md names both commands

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-docs
```

---
